baseline.name: garrido_published_unit_cost_assumption
baseline.provenance: Garrido 2024 section 3.1 assumption (6); replication baseline only, not calibrated MFSC prices

interpretation_boundary: The grid measures ranking sensitivity to relative prices; it does not estimate real monetary costs.
Strategic procurement and injection are reported as physical resources and are not silently folded into Garrido's seven-term kappa.
ReT and resource-feasibility remain the primary decision criteria; Cobb-Douglas is secondary.
A domain-calibrated result requires a signed seven-coefficient vector with units, price year, and source.
